items.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Dick Allen. Dick Allen is identified in the transcript as another person present at the recording session ('My name is Dick Allen'), but the interviewee provides no information about their personal or professional relationship.

ctx.x: We pay. I don't know what I paid now to get down, but I've been in there so long. We pay $0.50 every time a member die. And we have $2.50 if the dog die every month.

Yeah. And they tax you. It's like a tax, they call it, a member die. I know what you're talking about. I see how it works. Dick, you got anything you want to ask? Yeah, I want to ask. I don't really know what questions you've asked before.
